text: For D332509 at revision 3d29fe1d078b26b2f91ee102bc82cfd2308867f1, the AI inspection describes a disabled option that preserves the unavailable initial calendar's name. The reviewer suggested removing a comment; the AI proposed reducing repeated explanation while keeping that option behavior. Treat this as a reported contract of this selector revision, not a general rule for unavailable choices. The record reports that test_defaultsAndUnavailableCalendar passed, but supplies neither source nor independent execution evidence, and the proposed comment change was not accepted.
title: Unavailable calendar remains visible as a disabled option
